status: DRAFT_UNTIL_COMMIT; labels sealed; cube v2 pilot gate pending
question: Does one frozen OlmoEarth embedding cache of Korean 12-band Sentinel-2 cubes serve three tasks (land cover, deforestation, landslide) in new spatial clusters with 0/5/20 labels better than per-task raw models, and what is the amortized cost as tasks are added?

data.source: AI-Hub 71363, 594 tiles / 2,699 observation pairs, EPSG:32652 10 m 1024 px
data.cubes: AIHUB_CUBE_V2_CONTRACT (mosaic, 12-band common coverage >=99.9%, fail-closed); only experiment_eligible cubes
data.split: M10 frozen AOI-cluster spatial holdout: train C01,C11,C13 (393 tiles) / val C04,C09,C10 (84) / test C02,C03,C05,C06,C07,C08,C12 (113); sha256 in artifacts/aihub71363_spatial_holdout.json
data.model_view: primary = 10-band model view (B01/B09 missing in both Sen12 and Korea); 12-band = OlmoEarth-only sensitivity
data.tile_unit: 128 px chips on a fixed grid within each 1024 px tile (64 chips/tile) or full-tile embedding at 32x32 tokens per 128 px — decided before labels are opened (default: 128 px chips, same geometry as Sen12/Solar)

T1_land_cover.label: AI-Hub polygons -> pixel mask, classes forest/field/building/road (+background)
T1_land_cover.metric: per-cluster mIoU (4 classes), tie-correct AP per class
T1_land_cover.source_head: none -> O0 not defined; report O1/R1 and full-label references

T2_deforestation.label: binary mask (167 labelled tiles in inventory)
T2_deforestation.source_head: none (forest_loss_driver is tile classification, different contract) -> O0 not defined

T3_landslide.label: binary mask (90 labelled tiles)
T3_landslide.source_head: Sen12 P4 (cache) and P2 (raw) confirmatory heads -> O0/R0 defined; this is the external transfer Sen12 -> Korea

arms.O0: frozen cache + source head, 0 Korea labels (T3 only)
arms.O1: frozen cache + head adapted with K support chips (A1 protocol: BN frozen, 300 updates, lr 1e-4, stratified support from train clusters)
arms.R1: raw UNet3D adapted with the same K chips (A4w for T3; scratch/floor for T1/T2 since no raw source model)
arms.FULL_cache: cache head trained on all train-cluster labels (reference ceiling)
arms.FULL_raw: raw UNet3D trained on all train-cluster labels (reference ceiling)

support_rule: from train clusters only; query = the 7 test clusters; val clusters for threshold/epoch selection only
statistical_unit: test cluster (7) x task; success counted per cluster

success_rules.multi_task_reuse: O1 - R1 >= +0.01 in >= 5/7 clusters for >= 2 of 3 tasks at K=5 AND same direction at K=20
success_rules.external_transfer_T3: O0 >= R0 in >= 5/7 clusters (Sen12 -> Korea) and O1 > R1 >= 5/7
success_rules.cost: cache computed once; per-task adapter cost, raw bytes re-read, encoder GPU s, cache bytes reported; break-even number of tasks where cache pathway total cost < raw pathway total cost

forbidden: opening any Korea label before cubes, manifests, chips, source heads and this file are committed and hashed
using test clusters for any selection
reporting: per-task exclusion rate after v2 coverage gate (selection-bias audit, contract gate 6)
one opening only; results recorded whatever the sign
prerequisites: chip grid + OlmoEarth v1 cache (10-band view) over all eligible cubes, extracted once, hashed
Sen12 P4/P2 confirmatory heads reused unchanged
